# gradle-project

Gradle and Android build output inside a project. It is rebuilt by the next build.

**Name:** Gradle project build · **Category:** Project artifacts · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

## In projects

| Folder | Only when | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `build` | next to `build.gradle` or `build.gradle.kts` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `.gradle` | next to `build.gradle` or `build.gradle.kts` or `settings.gradle` or `settings.gradle.kts` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{.cxx,.externalNativeBuild}` | next to `build.gradle` or `build.gradle.kts` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |

To get it back: `./gradlew build`.

## In use

Items are Keep while one of these runs: `java|GradleDaemon`.
